# Recursive Solutions

> Run your firm on systems, not on the owner. Recursive Solutions is an AI consulting firm for owner-led professional services firms: accounting and tax, law, and engineering and consulting. One system for your website, content, SEO, leads, CRM and analytics, run by a hands-on team, plus custom automations, AI agents and advisory. The work is to diagnose where a firm loses margin and owner time, then design and deploy the most effective intervention, fixing the process before automating it.

## What we do

- **Lucy**: The unified platform behind Recursive Solutions: website, content, SEO, lead capture, CRM, and analytics in one system we run for you.
- **AI Opportunity Assessment**: Diagnose where the firm is losing margin and owner time, and identify the highest-leverage interventions before recommending any technology.
- **AI Advisory**: Ongoing guidance on AI strategy, tooling, and adoption for owners and leadership teams.
- **Custom AI Builds**: Bespoke AI systems designed around a firm's actual workflows and tools, not theoretical use cases.
- **Dedicated Agent Deployment**: 24/7 AI agents for customer support, internal operations, and data processing that work alongside teams.
- **Workflow Automation**: Eliminate repetitive tasks across sales, ops, and admin.
- **Operational Intelligence**: Live dashboards and real-time signals for professional services firms.

## How we work

Our engagement process is: **Discover** (understand what's actually broken) → **Design** (architect a custom solution around your tools and habits) → **Execute** (build and integrate) → **Optimize** (measure and improve).

## Who we serve

Owners of owner-led professional services firms (accounting and tax, law, and engineering and consulting) doing roughly $2M to $20M a year, where too much still waits on the owner. Every engagement is scoped to the firm's operation.

## How to start

Book a Consult through the contact form. We reply within one business day to set up a discovery call: thirty minutes, no pitch deck. You leave with a Friction Audit, an honest read on where you stand and where AI would actually pay off.
